title: Tax Estimate Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tax:estimate
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by tax_year
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when tax estimate data has stopped arriving for a given tax year.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per tax year and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your tax estimate feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
